feature.name: Pages
feature.what_it_does: Insert page-level structure: preformatted cover pages, blank pages, and page breaks.
feature.affects: the document's page structure and flow
feature.behavior: Insert page-level structure: preformatted cover pages, blank pages, and page breaks. Group controls: subfeature:cover-page-insert, subfeature:blank-page-insert, subfeature:page-break-insert

subfeatures.name: Cover Page
subfeatures.what_it_does: Inserts a preformatted, styled cover page (title/subtitle/date placeholders) at the start of the document, chosen from a gallery of designs.
subfeatures.affects: document content (adds a formatted first page)
subfeatures.behavior: Opens Cover Page (dropdown). Contents (20 controls): Color swatches, Line up, Position, Austin, Banded, Facet, Filigree, Grid, Integral, Page down, Ion (Dark), Ion (Light), Motion, Line down, Retrospect, Semaphore. [flyout of subfeature:cover-page-insert — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule; sections: Built-in] Appears as a page with a title band, labelled 'Cover Page'.

connections.why: all change the document's page structure/flow
all change the document's page structure/flow
cover pages are building blocks from the same gallery system

subfeatures.name: Blank Page
subfeatures.what_it_does: Inserts an empty page at the cursor position (measured: two page breaks around a new empty page).
subfeatures.behavior: Direct action: Inserts an empty page at the cursor position (measured: two page breaks around a new empty page). Applied immediately to document content (page flow); toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look. Appears as an empty page outline, labelled 'Blank Page'.

connections.why: all change the document's page structure/flow
all change the document's page structure/flow

subfeatures.name: Page Break
subfeatures.what_it_does: Ends the current page at the cursor and continues content on the next page (measured: doc + format delta).
subfeatures.behavior: Direct action: Ends the current page at the cursor and continues content on the next page (measured: doc + format delta). Applied immediately to document content (page flow); toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look. Appears as a page split by a dashed line, labelled 'Page Break'.
